title: Ukraine History Tracker Update — Wed May 06, 2026
summary: Russia killed 27 Ukrainians in a single day on May 5 — 12 in Zaporizhzhia and 6 in Kramatorsk from guided aerial bomb strikes, plus 5 at Naftogaz gas facilities (including 2 rescuers killed in a deliberate follow-up strike). Ukraine retaliated with the first combat use of its new FP-5 'Flamingo' cruise missile, reaching a Shahed/Iskander electronics factory in Cheboksary 1,200 km inside Russia, and knocked out the Kirishi oil refinery in Leningrad Oblast (7% of Russian refining capacity). Ukraine's self-declared open-ended ceasefire took effect at midnight May 6 — Russia violated it within minutes with 3 missiles and 108 drones, accumulating 1,820 documented violations by 10 AM. Events, map-lines, map-points, KPIs, econ, assets, strike-targets, political, and meta updated.

title: Ukraine History Tracker Update — Mon May 04, 2026
summary: Ukraine's drone forces struck Russian shadow fleet oil tankers and a cruise missile carrier near Novorossiysk in a massive 334-drone barrage on May 3, confirmed by Zelensky — hitting Russia's sanction-busting energy exports. Russia launched 268 drones plus an Iskander-M ballistic missile overnight May 2-3, killing 4 civilians in Chornomorsk, Dnipro, and Kherson despite 249 interceptions; a separate daytime barrage of 227 drones preceded it on May 2. Ukraine hit Russia's Tuapse refinery for a 4th time on May 1, driving Russia's processing capacity to a 16-year low of 4.69M bbl/day and costing Russia $7B+ in 2026. On the diplomatic front, Zelensky claimed 90-95% agreement on a peace framework with Trump while seeking details of Putin's May 9 Victory Day ceasefire proposal. Events, map-lines, map-points, kpis, econ, and meta updated.
